evidence: Scanning electron microscope and energy dispersive spectroscopy (SEM and EDS,Inspect F50, FEI) were used to observe the morphologies and chemical elements of the MoS2. Then, X -ray diffraction (XRD, Smartlab -3, Rigaku), Raman spectra (RAM-PRO-785E, Agiltron), and transmission electron microscopy (TEM, G220，FEI) were used to observed the crystal structures of the MoS2. Moreover, a plasma treatment (PDC -002, Harrick) was carried out on the surface of MoS2 with power input of 45 W. Contact angle measurement (OCA 15 plus, Dataphysics ) was used to estimate the hydrophilicity of MoS2 surface. Electrochemical impedance spectra (EIS) were measured over a frequency range of 105 to 0.1 Hz at a potential of 1.51 vs RHE. The iR correction to data with the series resistance is done by the equation of ηcorr = ηexp-iR. Moreover, the electrochemically active surface area (ECSA) was evaluated through the measurements of double -layer capacitance (Cdl) by cyclic voltammetry (CV) beginning at 0.96 and ending at 1.06 V vs. RHE with different scan rates from 10 to 100 mV/s.
